message: The emulation found no failing tests, and the design holds together: the read-only boundary, line-anchored drafts and human approval are all intact. It's blocked because none of these Azure components (Service Bus, Functions, Key Vault, Content Safety, Azure OpenAI, Cosmos DB) has a supported code generator yet. The only Azure contract today is private object storage, and squeezing this reviewer into that would drop the scope you asked us to keep. So this isn't something you can fix on the board. It's product engineering work: building native Azure generators for the queue, orchestrator, guard, model and drafts store. This emulation report (revision 2, artifact bcd741b3…) is the test case to reproduce the gaps. While that work happens, let's settle the open decision that shapes the drafts store and the reviewer path: should approved drafts be posted back to the PR as comments, which needs a separate write-capable step after approval, or should they only be shown to the reviewer for now?
